The zero-byte detection and byte replication/XOR snippets in src/bitstream.rs originate in Sean Eron Anderson’s Bit Twiddling Hacks. The individual code snippets are expressly public-domain unless marked otherwise; the two referenced snippets have no exception marking. The page aggregate and explanatory prose retain their separate copyright. This notice preserves origin without claiming the whole page is public-domain.
